description: This file contains utility code for testing HostResolverInternalResult objects in the net::dns namespace, including custom Google Test matchers for different result types and an operator for outputting results as JSON.

classes.name: HostResolverInternalResultBaseMatcher
classes.description: A base Google Test matcher class for matching HostResolverInternalResult objects with expected properties.

classes.name: HostResolverInternalDataResultMatcher
classes.description: A matcher for HostResolverInternalResult objects of type kData, checking endpoints, strings, and hosts.

classes.name: HostResolverInternalMetadataResultMatcher
classes.description: A matcher for HostResolverInternalResult objects of type kMetadata, checking metadatas.

classes.name: HostResolverInternalErrorResultMatcher
classes.description: A matcher for HostResolverInternalResult objects of type kError, checking error code.

classes.name: HostResolverInternalAliasResultMatcher
classes.description: A matcher for HostResolverInternalResult objects of type kAlias, checking alias target.

methods.name: ExpectHostResolverInternalDataResult
methods.description: Factory function returning a matcher for data results with specified properties.

methods.name: ExpectHostResolverInternalMetadataResult
methods.description: Factory function returning a matcher for metadata results with specified properties.

methods.name: ExpectHostResolverInternalErrorResult
methods.description: Factory function returning a matcher for error results with specified properties.

methods.name: ExpectHostResolverInternalAliasResult
methods.description: Factory function returning a matcher for alias results with specified properties.
